checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both hands remain closed around the barbell.
checks.feet: Forefeet stay on the step, heels move freely below and above step level. Straight knees and stable bar across the upper back.
checks.movement: Standing barbell calf raise on a step. Forefeet stay supported while both heels rise and lower; knees remain straight and bar stays across the upper back. 3.5 seconds rise, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds lower.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
